component.name: Deck Screen Share
component.summary: Stream the Steam Deck screen over a local network

description.p: Captures the Steam Deck display and system audio and sends them to the Deck Screen Share Windows receiver over TCP.
Connects PipeWire capture directly to the dynamically discovered Gamescope node path.
Discovers and links the dynamic Gamescope and GStreamer PipeWire port IDs.
Creates the PipeWire link without blocking the agent API.
Explicitly links the Gamescope video source to the GStreamer capture node.
Imports Gamescope DMA-BUF frames through OpenGL before passing them to FFmpeg.
Adds live PipeWire and capture diagnostics for failed preview connections.
Connects to the unrestricted PipeWire manager socket to receive the Gamescope recording stream.
Uses the Gamescope PipeWire recording stream and reliable TCP transport in Gaming Mode.
Keeps the SteamOS agent running when Gaming Mode closes its window and automatically discovers DRM devices.
Adds headless Gaming Mode support, version reporting, and improved capture diagnostics.
Adds persistent Windows receiver settings and preview-only connection testing.
